title: Combining fixed and free bit assignments
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P\subseteq[n]$, and choose a bit assignment in $\mathbb F_2$ on $P$ and one on $[n]\setminus P$. Combining them coordinatewise gives a bit assignment in $\mathbb F_2$ on $[n]$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a set of coordinates in $[n]$
